IndexInventory.Definition: CREATE INDEX idx_accounts_50m_covering ON eap_audit_20261028.accounts_50m USING btree (id) INCLUDE (balance, active)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_accounts_50m_id ON eap_audit_20261028.accounts_50m USING btree (id)

DiscrepancyReconciliation.Claim: Schema defined as 'id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY' in preliminary design documents.
DiscrepancyReconciliation.CatalogReality: No PRIMARY KEY constraint exists in pg_constraint. Uniqueness was enforced via a separate CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_accounts_50m_id ON accounts_50m (id).
DiscrepancyReconciliation.CoveringIndexStatus: idx_accounts_50m_covering is currently NON-UNIQUE (indisunique=false, indisprimary=false) and indexes (id) INCLUDE (balance, active).
DiscrepancyReconciliation.RedundancyAssessment: idx_accounts_50m_covering indexes the identical leading key (id) as idx_accounts_50m_id. Because PostgreSQL supports unique indexes with INCLUDE columns, idx_accounts_50m_id is completely redundant.
SafeMigrationPlan: 1. CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_accounts_50m_covering_unique ON eap_audit_20261028.accounts_50m (id) INCLUDE (balance, active);
2. ALTER TABLE eap_audit_20261028.accounts_50m ADD CONSTRAINT pk_accounts_50m PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX idx_accounts_50m_covering_unique;
3. DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS eap_audit_20261028.idx_accounts_50m_id;
